title: 土堤壓密與防滲~Levee compaction and seepage control
focus: 區分夯實、地基壓密與防滲失效的土堤推導~Levee reasoning that separates compaction, consolidation and seepage failure
summary: 由土料三相、調濕與乾密度出發，課程連結地基壓密時間、達西流徑、防滲牆阻抗、濾層及孔壓監測。每一步區分材料試驗與整體構造行為，特別避免把抗隆起比值當所有管湧的安全證明。西沙加緬度及紅河提供已核對背景，數學量值全部是獨立教學假設。~Starting from soil phases, conditioning and dry density, the course connects consolidation timing, Darcy paths, cutoff resistance, filters and pore-pressure monitoring. Each step distinguishes material tests from whole-structure behavior, especially avoiding claims that a heave ratio proves safety against all piping. West Sacramento and Red River provide verified context; every numerical value is an independent teaching assumption.

units.anchor: 含水量與乾密度~Moisture and dry density
units.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證~Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。相對夯實度還需對應相同土料及試驗能量的室內最大乾密度；不同級配、超粒徑修正或取樣位置會改變可比性，不能只追求單一百分比而忽略土層接合與滲透性。本例含水量以水重除乾土重定義，密度均為質量密度。數值只做換算，不把假設室內峰值或百分比當任何現場驗收標準。~Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air. Field wet density includes solids and water and must be converted using moisture content. Relative compaction additionally requires a laboratory maximum for compatible material and test energy. Gradation changes, oversize corrections and sampling location affect comparability, so one percentage cannot replace attention to lift bonding and permeability. Moisture is water mass divided by dry-solid mass, and densities are mass densities. This conversion does not make the assumed laboratory peak or resulting percentage a field acceptance criterion.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15. Dry density is 1.739 Mg/m³; relative to a laboratory maximum of 1.85 Mg/m³, compaction is 94.01%.
units.verify: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。沿每層厚度與接合帶安排檢查，異常時先追查土料和儀器校核，不能用另一處含水量替代。~Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment. Inspect lift thickness and transitions as well as point density; investigate material changes and instrument calibration before substituting moisture measurements from another location.
units.failure: 濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。~Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. A laboratory peak from different material misclassifies acceptance, while a dense surface can conceal an inadequately compacted lower part of a thick lift.
units.misconception: 現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。~Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance.
units.practice: 以兩組相同濕密度但不同含水量重算乾密度，再列出室內與現場必須一致的條件。說明為何密度比較仍不能代替滲透試驗和層間連續性檢查。~Recalculate dry density for equal wet densities at two moisture contents, then list laboratory and field comparability conditions. Explain why density comparison still cannot replace permeability testing and inspection of continuity between lifts.

units.anchor: 土料調濕與拌合~Moisture conditioning and blending
units.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證~Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 土料調濕改變施工時的可壓實性，但最佳含水量隨土性與夯實能量而異。加水計畫需以乾土質量建立水量帳，再考慮拌合均勻度、蒸發與雨水；平均含水量符合目標不代表每一團塊都符合，過濕或乾硬團塊仍可能留下不同變形與滲流通道。本例封閉水量帳假設乾土質量不變、加入的水全部保留，目標只是指定教學值，不宣稱位於最佳含水量或可立即施工。~Moisture conditioning changes compactability, but optimum moisture depends on material and compaction energy. Added water is calculated from dry-solid mass before accounting for mixing, evaporation and rainfall. Meeting an average moisture target does not mean every clod meets it; wet pockets and hard dry clods can produce contrasting deformation and seepage paths. The closed water balance holds dry mass fixed and retains all added water. The target is an assigned teaching value, not a demonstrated optimum or authorization to place the soil.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15. Required retained water ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg.
units.verify: 先核對含水量分母為乾土質量，追蹤加水計量、天候及拌合後各點試樣。利用試驗填築確認鬆鋪厚度、機具與遍數，並比較表層和內部含水量以辨識混合不均。~Confirm the dry-mass moisture denominator and track metered water, weather and samples after blending. Use trial placement to establish loose-lift thickness, equipment and passes, comparing surface and interior moisture to detect uneven mixing rather than relying solely on a delivered water total.
units.failure: 以濕土總重乘含水量差會算錯加水量，短時間表面灑水也可能只弄濕外皮；直接增加機具遍數未必能補救內部含水量不適或團塊未打散。~Multiplying moisture change by wet total mass gives the wrong dose. Brief surface spraying can wet only the exterior, and additional passes may not correct unsuitable interior moisture or clods that remain intact.
units.misconception: 只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。~A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
units.practice: 把乾土質量、水量與可能蒸發分開列帳，另設幾個混合後取樣點。比較平均合格但離散很大的情況，提出能辨識土團內外差異的驗證方式。~Separate dry mass, water dose and possible evaporation in a ledger, with several post-mixing sample locations. Compare a compliant mean with high scatter and propose verification that distinguishes clod interiors from their surfaces.

units.anchor: 孔隙比與飽和度~Void ratio and saturation
units.title: 孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證~Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 乾密度只描述單位總體積中的固體質量，配合土粒比重才能求孔隙比，再由含水量判斷孔隙中水與空氣的比例。相同乾密度可能對應不同飽和度與吸力，浸水後的濕陷或膨脹也不能由密度一項排除；三相圖是檢查量測一致性的工具，不是直接推定滲透係數的公式。本例土粒比重與水密度已指定，忽略溶解鹽及體積量測誤差。飽和度應介於零與一，超界值要追查輸入而非截斷後繼續計算。~Dry density describes solid mass per bulk volume. Particle specific gravity enables void ratio, and moisture then divides void space into water and air. Equal dry density can coexist with different saturation and suction; density alone does not exclude collapse or swelling on wetting. A phase diagram checks measurement consistency rather than directly predicting hydraulic conductivity. Specific gravity and water density are specified, with dissolved salts and volume error neglected. Saturation must lie between zero and one; an impossible value triggers input investigation rather than silent clipping.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.70、ρw=1.00、ρd=1.80 Mg/m³、w=0.15，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.50，Sr=wGs/e=0.81。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.70, water density 1.00 and dry density 1.80 Mg/m³, with moisture w=0.15. Void ratio e=0.50 and saturation Sr=0.81.
units.verify: 用三相圖核對質量與體積守恆，將飽和度與含水量、密度的不確定度一同呈現。若需要預估浸水行為，另做代表性應力下的濕陷、膨脹和滲透試驗，不能由單次相圖外推。~Check phase mass and volume closure and report saturation alongside uncertainty in moisture and density. When wetting behavior matters, conduct collapse, swelling and permeability tests under representative stresses instead of extrapolating those responses from one phase-diagram calculation.
units.failure: 錯把含水量當水體積比例會造成飽和度誤差，不同土粒比重也使同密度材料具有不同孔隙比；推定密實土必定不透水則可能忽略裂縫和連通大孔隙。~Confusing gravimetric moisture with a water-volume fraction distorts saturation, while different particle gravity changes void ratio at equal density. Declaring dense soil impermeable additionally ignores cracks and connected macropores through the fill.
units.misconception: 相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。~Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity.
units.practice: 固定乾密度並改變含水量，繪出孔隙中水與空氣的比例，再試算一組不可能的超飽和輸入。說明應回查哪些量測，而不是直接把結果改成百分之百。~Hold dry density fixed while varying moisture and draw the water/air shares of voids. Try an impossible supersaturated input and explain which measurements should be checked instead of forcing the result to one hundred percent.

units.anchor: 地基一次壓密沉陷~Primary consolidation settlement
units.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證~Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。正常固結土在指定應力範圍可用壓縮指數估算一次壓密量，但超固結、分層、次壓縮或側向變形需要另處理，不能把現場夯實百分比當作地基沉陷保證。本例為均質正常固結層的一維平均應力近似，使用常用十進對數。忽略側移與次壓縮，並不代表實際堤頂最終總沉陷。~Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil. New loading initially creates pore pressure; drainage then increases effective stress and reduces void space. A compression index estimates primary settlement for normally consolidated soil within its tested stress range. Overconsolidation, layering, secondary compression and lateral deformation require additional treatment beyond fill-density acceptance. This is a one-dimensional mean-stress estimate for a uniform normally consolidated layer using base-ten logarithms. Lateral movement and secondary compression are omitted, so the result is not total final crest settlement.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設H=4 m、Cc=0.25、e0=0.80、初始σ′0=100 kPa、增量Δσ′=50 kPa，S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa. Primary settlement S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m.
units.verify: 核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。利用沉陷板與孔壓同步觀測區別排水壓密與側移，並保留填築階段及水位變動紀錄。~Check sample quality, preconsolidation stress and the distribution of added stress, comparing a layered calculation. Observe settlement plates and pore pressures together to distinguish drainage-driven consolidation from lateral movement, retaining fill-stage and groundwater records when interpreting displacement.
units.failure: 把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。~Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress. Crest observations alone cannot separate foundation and fill contributions or identify the mechanism of continuing movement.
units.misconception: 填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。~Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
units.practice: 將一層地基分成兩個應力不同的子層並比較總沉陷，列出先期固結壓力不足時的資料缺口。規劃沉陷與孔壓配對觀測，避免只從單一沉陷值推斷原因。~Divide the foundation into two layers with different stress changes and compare total settlement. List missing preconsolidation information and plan paired settlement/pore-pressure observations instead of inferring the mechanism from one displacement value.

units.anchor: 排水路徑與壓密時間~Drainage path and consolidation time
units.title: 排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證~Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 一次壓密時間由排水距離平方和壓密係數控制；雙向排水時的最長路徑不同於整層厚度。壓密係數會隨應力與土層而變，排水邊界也可能因低透水覆層或堵塞而改變，因此施工階段的孔壓消散不能只由一個實驗值和日曆時間決定，需與沉陷歷線一起判讀。本例使用均質一維壓密的平均百分之九十時間因子，瞬時均布荷載且排水邊界固定。係數明列為平方公尺每秒，換算日數另除秒數。~Primary consolidation time scales with the square of drainage distance and inversely with the coefficient of consolidation. Double drainage changes the longest path relative to full layer thickness. Stress-dependent properties, low-permeability covers and clogged drains can alter the response, so elapsed time and one laboratory coefficient cannot alone establish field pore-pressure dissipation. The example uses the average ninety-percent time factor for uniform one-dimensional consolidation under instantaneous uniform loading and fixed drainage boundaries. The coefficient is in square metres per second, with a separate seconds-to-days conversion.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Tv,90=0.848、排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59日。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Tv,90=0.848, drainage length Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s. Time t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59 days.
units.verify: 在地質剖面標出可排水與不透水邊界，辨識實際最長路徑及分階段荷載。以多深度孔壓和沉陷反算時間尺度，再檢查相同係數能否描述不同階段而不是只擬合單一點。~Mark draining and impermeable boundaries on the ground profile and identify the longest path and staged loading. Compare multi-depth pore pressure and settlement against the time scale, testing whether one coefficient explains several stages rather than fitting a single observation.
units.failure: 把全層厚度誤當雙向排水路徑會放大時間估算，反向錯用則可能提早判定壓密完成；若忽略低透水夾層，名義上雙向排水也未必等於真實邊界。~Using full thickness for double drainage overstates time, while the opposite mistake can suggest premature completion. Low-permeability interlayers can also prevent nominal double drainage from representing the actual hydraulic boundary conditions.
units.misconception: 土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。~Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
units.practice: 比較同一層單向與雙向排水的路徑平方，再將秒與日逐項換算。提出可辨識排水邊界失效的孔壓觀測配置，並說明分段填築為何改變時間起點。~Compare squared drainage distances for single and double drainage and convert seconds to days explicitly. Design pore-pressure observations to identify a failed drainage boundary and explain why staged filling changes the loading time origin.

units.anchor: 滲流量與流徑長度~Seepage discharge and path length
units.title: 滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證~Seepage discharge and path length mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 達西流量由滲透係數、過水面積及水力坡降共同決定，坡降是總水頭差除流徑長度，並非只有水位差。堤身和地基通常具有分層與異向性，簡化一維流線只能建立尺度；總漏水量偏小也可能伴隨局部集中的危險出口，故流量與局部梯度需要分開檢查。本例採飽和、均質、固定截面的恆定一維流，面積垂直於流向。未模擬自由水面、接縫或繞過防滲構造的流線。~Darcy discharge combines hydraulic conductivity, flow area and hydraulic gradient, which is total-head difference divided by path length rather than head difference alone. Embankments and foundations are commonly layered and anisotropic, so a one-dimensional path supplies only a scale. A small total discharge may still accompany a concentrated adverse exit gradient. The example assumes steady saturated one-dimensional flow through a uniform constant section, with area normal to flow. It omits the phreatic surface, joints and paths around seepage-control structures.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、厚5 m、寬100 m、Δh=3 m、L=30 m，Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, thickness 5 m, width 100 m, head difference 3 m and length 30 m. Darcy discharge Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s.
units.verify: 標出總水頭測點、流向、面積和路徑長度，核對滲透試驗方向與現場分層。用實測孔壓和排水流量一起校核；如有異向性、裂縫或明顯自由面，改採能表示該幾何的模型。~Label total-head points, flow direction, area and path length, checking test orientation against layering. Calibrate with both pore pressures and drain discharge; where anisotropy, cracks or a moving free surface matter, use a model that represents that geometry explicitly.
units.failure: 漏掉流徑長度會造成量綱錯誤，誤用沿流向面積也會使流量失真；只以總流量穩定判定安全，則可能看不到局部裂縫流逐漸集中與顆粒流失。~Omitting path length creates a dimensional error, and using area parallel to flow distorts discharge. Stable total leakage alone can conceal progressively concentrated crack flow and soil loss within a small part of the system.
units.misconception: 達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。~Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length.
units.practice: 把水頭差和流長各改一倍，分別比較坡降與流量，再畫出測點高程。說明總水頭含壓力水頭與位置水頭，避免把不同高度的壓力表直接相減。~Double head difference and path length separately and compare gradient and discharge. Draw measurement elevations and explain total head as pressure plus elevation head, avoiding direct subtraction of pressure readings at different heights.

units.anchor: 出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別~Exit heave versus internal erosion
units.title: 出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證~Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 向上滲流的滲透力可抵消顆粒的浮重，在理想非黏性土柱中有效應力趨近零時可能隆起。這種垂直臨界梯度分析不等於水平逆向侵蝕或裂縫集中沖蝕的門檻；內部侵蝕還受級配、濾層、幾何與缺陷控制，不能把抗隆起比值命名為涵蓋一切管湧的安全係數。本例無覆載、均質非黏性土且出口垂直向上，僅比較理想臨界梯度與指定局部梯度；不能據此核准堤防或濾層配置。~Upward seepage force can counter submerged particle weight, approaching zero effective stress in an ideal cohesionless column and allowing heave. This vertical critical-gradient calculation is not the onset criterion for horizontal backward erosion or concentrated crack erosion. Internal erosion also depends on gradation, filters, geometry and defects, so a heave ratio cannot represent every piping mechanism. The example has no surcharge and uses uniform cohesionless soil with vertical upward exit flow. It compares ideal critical and assigned local gradients only, not approval of an embankment or filter arrangement.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.65、e=0.65、垂直出口梯度ie=0.40，icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00，理想抗隆起比icr/ie=2.50。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.65, e=0.65 and vertical exit gradient ie=0.40. Ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00; heave ratio icr/ie=2.50.
units.verify: 確認出口梯度的方向與取樣距離，檢查覆載、土性和排水層接觸。另行建立逆向侵蝕、集中漏水與濾層失效情境，配對觀測排水量、濁度及地表隆起，不能只看單一梯度比。~Confirm gradient direction and sampling distance and check surcharge, material and drain contacts. Separately assess backward erosion, concentrated leaks and filter failure, observing discharge, turbidity and heave together instead of treating a single gradient ratio as the entire seepage assessment.
units.failure: 粗網格平均梯度可能掩蓋局部出口峰值，黏性土裂縫也不符合無黏土柱假設；把大於一的比值當全面安全會漏掉可在不同條件下發展的侵蝕通道。~A coarse averaged gradient can hide an exit peak, and cracks in cohesive soil violate the ideal granular-column assumption. A ratio above unity does not exclude erosion paths developing under distinctly different conditions elsewhere in the foundation.
units.misconception: 抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。~A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.
units.practice: 將垂直隆起與沿弱層逆向侵蝕各畫一張機理圖，列出它們需要的不同資料。比較縮短梯度取樣距離的影響，說明為何必須同時觀測帶砂出水。~Draw separate mechanisms for vertical heave and backward erosion along a weak layer, listing their different data needs. Compare shorter gradient measurement distances and explain why sediment-bearing seepage must also be observed.

units.anchor: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗~Cutoff walls and series resistance
units.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證~Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 低透水防滲牆可以增加理想流路的水力阻抗，但效果取決於接頭、嵌入深度和周邊地層連續性。串聯阻抗把每段長度除滲透係數與面積後相加，適合展示低透水薄層的重要性；真實水流會繞過牆尖、側緣或施工缺陷，所以一維小流量不代表牆後壓力和局部出口都已降低。本例所有水量必須依序通過兩段相同截面，牆無缺陷且不存在繞流；僅為阻抗比較，不能當二維防滲牆設計成果。~A low-conductivity cutoff increases resistance along an ideal path, but effectiveness depends on joints, penetration and surrounding strata. Series resistance sums each length divided by conductivity and area, illustrating a thin low-permeability layer. Actual flow may bypass tips, edges or defects, so a small one-dimensional discharge does not prove favorable downstream pressures and exit gradients. All flow in this example crosses two equal-area sections in series through a defect-free wall without bypass. It is a resistance comparison rather than a two-dimensional cutoff-wall design result.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δh=3 m、A=10 m²，牆厚0.6 m、kw=10⁻⁹ m/s，土長29.4 m、ks=10⁻⁵ m/s，Q=Δh/[Lw/(kwA)+Ls/(ksA)]=4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δh=3 m and A=10 m²: wall Lw=0.6 m, kw=10⁻⁹ m/s; soil Ls=29.4 m, ks=10⁻⁵ m/s. Series discharge is 4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s.
units.verify: 核對牆體連續性、施工接頭和嵌入地層，將穿牆與繞牆路徑分開建模。用牆前後孔壓及排水量辨識壓降位置，必要時檢查不連續缺陷，避免只比較材料試體的滲透係數。~Verify wall continuity, joints and the penetrated stratum, modeling through-wall and bypass paths separately. Use upstream/downstream pressures and discharge to locate head loss, investigating discontinuities where necessary instead of comparing laboratory wall-material conductivity alone as evidence of overall performance.
units.failure: 低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。~A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity. One permeable defect creates a parallel path that invalidates the series model, while deeper penetration without checking exits may concentrate head loss in an unfavorable location.
units.misconception: 牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。~Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant.
units.practice: 在串聯模型旁增設一條假設平行缺陷，分別列各路的壓差和阻抗。比較總流量及壓降分配，指出現場哪些量測能區分材料不良與繞流問題。~Add a hypothetical parallel defect beside the series path and list head differences and resistances separately. Compare total discharge and head-loss distribution, identifying measurements that distinguish poor wall material from hydraulic bypass.

units.anchor: 濾層保土與通水~Filter retention and drainage
units.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證~Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 濾層需在土料流失前形成可靠的顆粒截留，同時讓水排出而不累積不利孔壓。粒徑比是篩選工具，適用界線取決於基土類別、細料比例、分散性和採用的設計程序；施工離析、污染或濾層中斷會使合格室內級配失去意義，因此保土、通水與連續性都需驗證。本例只算兩個粒徑比，未指定土類或完整設計準則，因此不能標示濾層合格。粒徑均取各自累積通過曲線對應百分位。~Filters must retain migrating base particles while passing water without adverse pressure buildup. Particle-size ratios are screening tools whose limits depend on base-soil category, fines, dispersivity and the selected procedure. Segregation, contamination or interrupted placement can defeat a compliant laboratory gradation, so retention, drainage and continuity all require verification in the completed work. The example computes two grain-size ratios without specifying soil class or a complete design procedure, so it cannot declare acceptance. Diameters refer to the appropriate percent-finer points on their respective curves.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm. Screening ratios are D15/d85=3 and D15/d15=12, without an acceptance claim.
units.verify: 核對代表性基土完整級配與分散性，按選定手冊土類步驟設計並檢查濾料生產範圍。施工時追蹤離析、厚度、污染和接縫，必要時用相容性試驗驗證，而不是只留兩個比值。~Check representative full base gradations and dispersivity, follow the chosen manual’s soil-category procedure and review production limits. Inspect segregation, thickness, contamination and transitions during placement, using compatibility testing when needed instead of retaining only two screening ratios in the acceptance record.
units.failure: 用平均基土掩蓋最不利細粒層會漏掉保土需求，運輸離析又可能形成局部粗料窗；即使顆粒比合理，濾層中斷仍讓集中滲流直接侵蝕未保護基土。~An averaged base soil can hide a critical finer layer, and transport segregation can create coarse windows. Even plausible particle ratios cannot protect base soil where an interrupted filter exposes it directly to concentrated seepage flow.
units.misconception: 兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。~Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.
units.practice: 用同一濾料對兩種基土重算比值，列出尚缺的土類和分散性資料。畫出轉角與穿堤構造旁的濾層接續，說明級配計算無法替代施工連續性檢查。~Apply one filter to two base soils and recalculate ratios, listing missing classification and dispersivity data. Draw filter continuity at corners and conduits, explaining why grading arithmetic cannot replace inspection of physical continuity.

units.anchor: 孔壓監測與總水頭~Pore-pressure monitoring and total head
units.title: 孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證~Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 孔壓計量到的是感測點附近壓力，解讀滲流需要把壓力水頭加到感測器高程，並統一氣壓補償與時間基準。若不分感測器高度而直接比較壓力數值，可能誤判流向；水頭變化還應結合排水流量、濁度和填築歷史，才能區別洪水邊界變動、儀器漂移與局部異常。本例使用已扣氣壓的表壓與同一高程基準，忽略速度水頭。總水頭是該點水力勢，不自動等於另一處自由地下水面位置。~A piezometer measures pressure near its sensor; seepage interpretation adds pressure head to sensor elevation and aligns atmospheric compensation and timestamps. Comparing pressure alone at different heights can reverse an inferred flow direction. Head changes should also be assessed with discharge, turbidity and construction history to distinguish changing flood boundaries, instrument drift and local anomalies. The example uses gauge pressure after atmospheric correction and one elevation datum, neglecting velocity head. Point total head represents hydraulic potential, not automatically the free groundwater surface at another location.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測器高程z=12 m、表孔壓u=29.43 kPa、水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³，總水頭h=z+u/γw=15 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume sensor elevation z=12 m, gauge pore pressure u=29.43 kPa and water unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Total head h=z+u/γw=15 m.
units.verify: 保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。比較多測點總水頭和出水量濁度，異常先交叉檢核儀器及邊界，不用單支感測器代表整段堤防。~Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes. Compare total head across instruments with discharge and turbidity, cross-checking equipment and boundaries before allowing one sensor to represent an entire embankment reach.
units.failure: 基準高程錯誤會使所有水頭判讀系統性偏移，堵塞或失聯也可能假裝平穩；如果只設水位警戒而不追蹤出砂，即使孔壓變化不大仍可能漏掉侵蝕發展。~An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability. A stage-only alarm without sediment observations can miss erosion developing even when measured pore-pressure changes remain modest.
units.misconception: 兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。~The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation.
units.practice: 給兩支不同高度感測器相同表壓，計算總水頭並判斷可能流向。再加入儀器零點偏移，列出需要哪些獨立量測才能區分真實滲流改變與感測錯誤。~Give two sensors at different elevations equal gauge pressures, compute total heads and infer possible flow direction. Add a zero offset and list independent observations needed to distinguish an actual seepage change from measurement error.

example: 敏感度固定一維均質層的排水長2 m及百分之九十時間因子0.848，只把壓密係數由1.0×10⁻⁷提高到1.1×10⁻⁷ m²/s。時間由392.59降至356.90日，減少9.09%，並非減少百分之十；壓密係數在分母，所以必須用倒數比例。此比較假設排水邊界、荷載與土性模型均不變，不能代表打設排水板或改變填築速度後的現場工期。這些變更還會影響排水路徑、塗抹區、井阻與荷載歷程，應另建立模型並以多深度孔壓及沉陷歷線檢核。~Hold drainage length at 2 m and the ninety-percent time factor at 0.848 for a uniform one-dimensional layer, increasing consolidation coefficient from 1.0×10⁻⁷ to 1.1×10⁻⁷ m²/s. Time decreases from 392.59 to 356.90 days, a 9.09% reduction rather than ten percent because the coefficient enters the denominator. This comparison holds drainage boundaries, loading and the material model fixed. It does not predict construction time after adding vertical drains or changing fill rate. Such changes can alter drainage distance, smear, well resistance and loading history, requiring a different model checked against multi-depth pore-pressure and settlement histories. The uncertainty in the coefficient should therefore remain visible alongside the computed time.
history: 墾務局於2011年發布土石壩濾層章、2012年發布填築施工章，2014年滲流章進一步區分出口隆起與其他侵蝕機制。這些文件提供可轉用的土工機理，不是所有地區堤防的驗收規範。工兵團2013年公告西沙加緬度南河路退縮堤防防滲牆完成，並指出堤體已於前一年完成；不與南港其他分期工程混淆。曼尼托巴官方另列紅河分洪系統西堤。本課不把教學密度、滲透係數或施工時程歸屬上述工程。~Reclamation published its embankment-dam filter chapter in 2011, construction chapter in 2012 and seepage chapter in 2014, distinguishing exit heave from other erosion mechanisms. These provide transferable geotechnical principles, not universal levee acceptance criteria. A 2013 Corps announcement reports completion of the South River Road setback-levee cutoff in West Sacramento and identifies the embankment as completed the previous year; it is not conflated with other Southport phases. Manitoba separately identifies the Floodway West Dike. Lesson densities, conductivities and timing are not attributed to these projects.

timeline.event: 墾務局濾層章發布，說明保土、通水與施工連續性。~Reclamation publishes its filter chapter addressing retention, drainage and continuity.
墾務局填築施工章發布，提供土料調濕與夯實背景。~Reclamation publishes its construction chapter covering conditioning and compaction.
工兵團公告南河路退縮堤防防滲牆完成。~The Corps announces completion of the South River Road setback-levee cutoff.

Time t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59 days.
